studies.title: Single-site bench comparison of membrane conditioning
studies.limitations: One water source and one operator; seasonal variability unmeasured

studies.title: Pilot membrane conditioning with matched controls
studies.outcome: Mean throughput improves 8 percent with no material change in rejection
studies.limitations: Pilot equipment; scale-up energy and maintenance costs not measured

studies.title: Multi-site replication under variable source conditions
studies.design: 180 runs across six sites with randomized treatment order
studies.outcome: Throughput difference minus 1 percent; interval minus 4 to plus 2 percent
studies.limitations: Protocol varied across site operators; no overall throughput advantage detected
